385 . A supply kit is dropped from an airplane flying at an altitude of 250 feet. Simplify $\sqrt{\frac{250}{16}}$ to determine how many seconds it takes for the supply kit to reach the ground.

386 . A flare is dropped into the ocean from an airplane flying at an altitude of 1,200 feet. Simplify $\sqrt{\frac{1200}{16}}$ to determine how many seconds it takes for the flare to reach the ocean.
387 . ⓐ Simplify $\sqrt{\frac{27}{3}}$ and explain all your steps. ⓑ Simplify $\sqrt{\frac{27}{5}}$ and explain all your steps. ⓒ Why are the two methods of simplifying square roots different?

388 . ⓐ Approximate $\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$ by dividing $\frac{1}{1.414}$ using long division without a calculator. ⓑ Rationalizing the denominator of $\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$ gives $\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} .$ Approximate $\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$ by dividing $\frac{1.414}{2}$ using long division without a calculator. ⓒ Do you agree that rationalizing the denominator makes calculations easier? Why or why not?
